title: Your First Hermes Bot: Questions Answered, Calls Booked, CRM Updated

sections.label: 1 - THE BOT TALKS TO STUDENTS AND PARENTS
sections.note: The bot answers from your own information and learns what each family needs. Anything sensitive goes straight to a person.

sections.label: 2 - CONNECTED TO YOUR TOOLS
sections.note: Every conversation ends in a booked next step, and the lead lands in your CRM so nobody retypes it.

sections.label: 3 - TESTED BEFORE LAUNCH, KEPT RUNNING AFTER
sections.note: You asked for someone who tests their own work, so every path gets tested first, and the bot is kept up to date as things change.

nodes.label: 1 - A student or parent asks the bot a question on your website or social page
2 - The bot answers from your own program details, dates and prices
3 - It asks a few questions to learn the student's grade, goals and start date
4 - Does the question need a real person, like a complaint or a special case?
4b - If it does, the bot hands the chat to your team and tells them why
5 - If not, the bot offers a call or the next enrollment step and books it
6 - The lead and the full chat are sent to your CRM by webhook
7 - Your team gets a notification with the details they need for the call
8 - Before launch, I run test chats through every path and fix what breaks
9 - After launch, I update the bot as your programs and dates change

input_sample.message: My son is in 10th grade and needs help before the SAT in the spring. What do you offer?
